sourceSentences: [0] (Bibou 31:20) Le seul problème, ça va être niveau 1 ou 2 parce que Zerry est quand même très faible. [...] ces autoattaques ne traversent pas les champions ni les CS.

[0] (Bibou 03:31) quand ce Z il va toucher un mur avant de toucher quelqu'un, il va changer de forme et on va avoir tout ce rectangle là qui [...] va exploser et va faire des dégâts à tout ce qui se trouve dedans.
[0] (Bibou 15:29) Zerry, elle a peu de range et elle va galérer si c'est contre un Z, contre un Xerat, contre n'importe quoi.
[0] (Bibou 31:20) des champions comme Tristana qui qui vont dachine et cetera qui peut potentiellement me suivre, ça va être compliqué.
[1] (Crownie 00:54) I would say Zeri's weak points is playing against poke or being outranged or kited. As I said, she's hyper reliant on her ultimate because it's such a massive steroid.

[1] (Crownie 01:08) So if she's kited in fights, it makes it much harder for her to play the game and if you're ultimate's out, you are essentially half of the champion that you are with your ultimate. And coupled with the fact that she doesn't really have a lot of all in potential in lane pre-six is also a big issue for her
[1] (Crownie 02:28) It's very important when you play mobile champions to try to save your dash for as long as possible until enemy commits their skills and then you can use it aggressively.
[1] (Crownie 02:44) I use it at a moment and then it just gets kited out by them flashing out or they use a spell to disengage and then again I'm so useless after.
[1] (Crownie 06:49) Try to look for short trades with Q auto into get out or like W from a bush or try to W a wall. Pre-six, Zeri isn't really super good at all ins unless she gets a lot of free hits
[1] (Crownie 09:06) using your W. It's good to use it like this when they like can't side step, right? They don't have much space to move. Or you can use it while W-ing on the wall.

[2] (junniseoul 15:46) As for your queue, just keep in mind that it's a stops at the first enemy hit skill shot. Since this is our DPS ability, it really reinforces the idea of playing front to back. Zeri's effective range is kind of short
[2] (junniseoul 16:20) Zeri's E should be used only one of two ways, as a get out of jail free card or as a follow up tool.
[2] (junniseoul 17:33) As for your ults, you want to use it when you're full committing in fights, but be wary as popping it too early could just make enemies flee instead of fighting you.

[2] (junniseoul 21:49) Versus Vayne, Aphelios, Nilah post-six, they kind of just out-stat check you. For the most part, the only way you can kill them is to out-space them, but it's difficult to out-space them as they have ways to either gap close or to just lock down and kill you.
[2] (junniseoul 22:08) Ashe level one to two just completely out-ranges you and cripples you, so she can literally run you down if you aren't mindful about your positioning.

[2] (junniseoul 22:23) most match-ups for Zeri are not very favorable as Zeri struggles in lane. And turn of that though, she wins most match-ups once she gets level six just because of how much her R offers her.
[2] (junniseoul 23:39) Zeri doesn't do well in extended trades in the early game, which is why I like going for those short bursty trades and try to have control of the wave.
